title: Backward Pass over a Computation Graph
signature: def graph_backward(ops, parents, inputs, output) -> tuple
hints: The node list is not in topological order. Sort it first, with Kahn's algorithm or a DFS post-order.
Run the forward pass in topological order and the backward pass in reverse topological order.
Each node pushes grad[node] * local_derivative into grad[parent] with +=. A node can be a parent twice, as in mul(a, a).
Start with every grad at 0 and grad[output] = 1. Nodes the output doesn't depend on keep a grad of 0.
